name: hn-telegram-bot
description: A Telegram group bot for news, market quotes, economic calendars and owner diagnostics on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.setup: npm run kv:create && echo 'Now run: npm run secrets'
scripts.secrets: echo 'Run: wrangler secret put TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN' && echo 'Run: wrangler secret put TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID' && echo 'Run: wrangler secret put TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET'
